thread:
jia_ingest: heads-up — while walking a new user through the node sample app I hit two noisy issues: request IDs sometimes missing from logs and our redaction rule missed an API key that appears embedded in JSON. not sure if it's an ordering bug or regex fuzziness.

matt_dev: can you paste the logs + minimal repro?

jia_ingest: yup. boot sequence output (sanitized-ish):
```
2026-03-01T12:03:21Z INFO  Starting sample-app
2026-03-01T12:03:21Z DEBUG init otel hooks attached
2026-03-01T12:03:21Z INFO  RequestId=null POST /v1/chat 200 45ms "user-agent: sample/0.1"
2026-03-01T12:03:21Z INFO  Event=user.create payload={"name":"alice","key":"sk_live_ABC123XYZ"}
```
redaction rules in app config: `/sk_live_[A-Z0-9]{6,}/` — but the key survived. reqid is also showing null for the first http log.

sara_ops: looks like otel/context maybe attaching after the express logger runs. are you using automatic logger init from our SDK?

jia_ingest: yes, calling `redwood-sdk.init({otel:true, logging:true})` as part of start, but i still see `init otel hooks attached` before the null req log. the SDK autoinit order in node sample is: 1) load .env, 2) init logger (w/ redaction middleware), 3) init otel. so that should be fine.

matt_dev: hmm — two possibilities: 1) requestId generator is a per-request middleware that runs after logger middleware on first pass so first log in the request has no id, 2) redaction uses a string blacklist that only runs on top-level strings and not on JSON payloads when logger serializes object across multiple steps.

sara_ops: can you repro with a tiny express handler? also paste logger config.

jia_ingest: small repro:
```
const express = require('express');
const app = express();
const rws = require('redwood-sdk');

rws.init({otel:true, logging:{level:'debug', redaction:['sk_live_']}});
app.use(rws.middleware.logger); // attaches req.id and redaction
app.post('/v1/chat', (req, res) => {
  console.log('incoming', req.body); // first log
  req.log.info('handler start', {payload: req.body});
  res.sendStatus(200);
});
```
output: first console.log shows no req id and full key; the structured `req.log.info` includes reqid and redacted key.

matt_dev: okay that nails ordering. `console.log` bypasses our logger and redaction. but your example also shows `logger` was a middleware — is console.log executed before the middleware runs? in express the middleware order matters: `app.use(logger)` before route should be fine though.

jia_ingest: it's not just console.log — even some framework debug logs in startup use the global console before we swap console to the SDK wrapper. we do swap console in the SDK but only after otel init currently. if otel init is async it delays the console shim and request id attachment.

sara_ops: so root cause: SDK's autoinit order causes a small window where plain console/stdout logs aren't wrapped and redaction isn't applied. plus our redaction only applies to the logger wrapper, not raw console.

matt_dev: proposed short-term fix: immediately shim console sync at the top of init, before any async otel setup. also change redaction to run as a post-process on stdout writes as a fallback. long term: document ordering clearly and add a test that stress starts sample app and scans stdout for uncovered API-like tokens.

dev-tools-bot: created ticket RW-5432 to track: "console shim early + stdout-level redaction + express middleware ordering test" — assigned to matt_dev, priority=P2.

jia_ingest: thanks — will try the console shim locally and report back. in addition can we add a small note to onboarding quickstart: "avoid raw console.log for production until SDK fully initialized"? new users keep hitting this.

matt_dev: agreed. i'll add a short paragraph + example ordering snippet to the quickstart.

sara_ops: also adding a tiny e2e test that starts the sample app and asserts the first http log has a reqid and no raw-looking keys.

jia_ingest: re-tested with local shim (patched rws.init to call `require('rws/console-shim').install()` synchronously) — first log now shows a reqid and `key` replaced with `[REDACTED]`. patch works. leaving notes in RW-5432. :thumbsup:

matt_dev: solid. follow-up: we should audit other SDKs (python/go) for same race. i'll open RW-5433 for SDK parity.

sara_ops: thanks everyone, great catch on the fuzzy redaction + init ordering.

jia_ingest: marking this thread resolved for sample-app onboarding.
